text: Python is a high-level programming language known for readable syntax and broad use in software development.
Python lists are ordered, mutable collections that can contain multiple values.
Python tuples are ordered collections that are immutable after creation.
Python dictionaries store data as key-value pairs and provide fast lookup by key.
Python sets are unordered collections of unique elements.
A Python function is a reusable block of code that performs a specific task and can accept parameters.
A Python class is a blueprint for creating objects and defining their attributes and methods.
Exception handling in Python uses try and except blocks to handle errors without immediately stopping the program.
Pandas is a Python library commonly used for data manipulation and analysis.
A pandas DataFrame is a two-dimensional labeled data structure with rows and columns.
NumPy provides support for numerical computing and multidimensional arrays in Python.
Matplotlib is a Python library used to create charts and visualizations.
Machine learning is a method in which algorithms learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions.
Supervised learning uses labeled examples to learn a relationship between input features and target values.
Classification is a supervised learning task in which a model predicts a category or class.
Regression is a supervised learning task in which a model predicts a continuous numerical value.
K-means clustering groups data points into a chosen number of clusters based on similarity.
A decision tree makes predictions by applying a sequence of rules based on feature values.
Random forests combine predictions from multiple decision trees to improve robustness and generalization.
Train-test splitting separates data into training and testing sets so model performance can be evaluated on unseen data.
